::: {.need #REQ-001 type="functional-requirement" status="approved" verified-by="TC-001"}
## Authenticate administrators

The service shall authenticate administrators before granting access.

### Rationale

A signed-off requirement whose only test has no evidence behind it is a
promise with nothing keeping it.
:::

::: {.need #TC-001 type="test-case" status="passed"}
## Administrator login test

The suite signs an administrator in and asserts the session opens.

### Rationale

This is the verification the requirement points at -- but nothing proves
it ever ran.
:::
